reviews.title: Watch properties
reviews.text: I would have given this a higher score, but the longer that I’ve had it the worse that I ever felt about it. I’ve had different questions come up that I can’t find any category to look for it under and when I do, my question isn’t answered. At the time of purchase, I actually bought two watches thinking that way I could switch them out whenever one needed to be charged. However, as time has gone by one of the watches does not stay charged for as long as I think that should and definitely not as long as the other watch. I came across a problem the other day where I found a new watch face that I liked, and I was going to apply it, but all I could do was download it…..or so I thought. At first, I thought maybe that the number of faces allowed on the watch itself was too many and I was going to delete some, but I couldn’t find anywhere any instructions on how to do it. I couldn’t even find that information in the help section of the app. So among other things, this is my biggest problem(s).

reviews.title: SN-60 WATCH
reviews.text: This WATCH works about as good as the fabled chinese escalators! Honestly it’s cheap chinese JUNK. I woke today to have a black screen with no reason for it being so. It was fully charged two days prior. Un-did the app and rebooted the device! With No so luck on a working device again.🤔 Two hours later it was showing the time after I picked it back up. Here I thought the home app might of been down for maintenance so I re-uploaded the App again. Only to realize that the watch was again in dark mode. Meaning it wasn’t working again. I like products that you can at least count on to tell the time of day! So frustrating to see that you are working on your health only to be stymied by a cheap watch! So I ordered another watch that I owned before that lasted for years. I only wish I did it before I bought this monstrosity of a product.

reviews.title: Software Review
reviews.text: I have had the watch for about 1 year.  The watch has performed very well.  It holds a charge well for a long time and when it is plugged in it charges very rapidly.  The big issue I have with the software.  The phone software is relatively easy to navigate until recently when the advertisements started being a constant problem.  When you open the programming on the phone an advertisement comes on the entire screen and it is very loud.  After several frustrating attempts to access the software, the commercial takes over and you are unable to get to the software control panel.  I have had to remove the software on my phone and reload it again to get it working again.  Because of this issue I would not recommend the watch purchase until the software problem is corrected.

reviews.title: Repetitive
reviews.text: I have to constantly update my settings back because the watch/app can’t seem to understand that I am measuring in lbs, not kg. Or feet/inches rather than cm. I cannot use the sleep feature because it is only active between certain times (before 10am) & I work nights so I am sleeping during the day. The most annoying thing is it doesn’t attach to Bluetooth half of the time and the other half I can’t get it to stop playing stuff to my watch automatically instead of my phone. & my watch face changes 2-3 times a day, I have never changed it on purpose. I only got this for health reasons and I can’t use half of the features because they don’t sync or I am need to use them during times the app doesn’t feel is appropriate.
